_comment: Which golden rules are promoted out of their chapter and into the two headline
tiers of the viva deck. Read by tools/viva-extract.php; the order here is the
order they appear in GOLDEN-RULES.md and in the deck, so it is rehearsal order,
This is the one editorial judgement in an otherwise generated pipeline. The twelve
run in the order the ideas depend on each other: the log, then ordering, then the
durability and delivery arguments that everything downstream rests on.
Note the shape of this list against the Java one. No advert here asks for Kafka
alone, so the questions that decide the interview are the model questions — what
the log guarantees and what it does not — rather than API surface.
Every entry must be a slug that tools/viva-extract.php --candidates prints. A slug
that no longer exists is reported as a WARNING rather than silently dropped.
